name: Luna
description: Luna is a friendly, high-energy Lab who loves fetch, swimming, and meeting new people. She is house-trained and does well with kids.

name: Milo
description: Milo is a laid-back tabby who enjoys sunny windowsills and chin scratches. He gets along with other cats and is litter-trained.

name: Bella
description: Bella is a curious young beagle with a great nose and a happy howl. She is learning basic commands and would love an active family.

name: Oliver
description: Oliver is a big, gentle Maine Coon with a fluffy coat and a calm personality. He follows his people from room to room.

name: Charlie
description: Charlie is a sweet, well-mannered golden who knows sit, stay, and shake. He is great with children and other dogs.

name: Sadie
description: Sadie is a smart, quick-learning border collie who needs daily exercise and a job to do. She would thrive with an experienced owner.
